mapper.select: SELECT id FROM l_admin WHERE account = #{account}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO l_admin ( group_id, account, name, password, salt, description, status, add_time ) VALUES ( #{groupId}, #{account}, #{name}, #{password}, #{salt}, #{description}, #{status}, #{addTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.*, ag.name groupName, (SELECT login_time FROM l_admin_login_record WHERE admin_id = a.id ORDER BY login_time DESC LIMIT 1) last_login_time FROM l_admin a LEFT JOIN l_admin_group ag ON a.group_id = ag.id WHERE a.id = #{id}
